skills.name: Cannon Boost
skills.description: Improves the cannon to permanently increase ATT and DEF.

skills.name: Fortune's Favor
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Cannon Blaster
skills.description: Shoots a flame bomb that attacks multiple enemies.

skills.name: Cannon Strike
skills.description: Fires Cannon Strike at a nearby enemy.

skills.name: Blast Back
skills.description: Fires the cannon while quickly moving backwards. Can decrease the speed of target for a fixed period of time.

skills.name: Cannon Leap
skills.description: Use while in the middle of a jump to jump even farther. The higher the skill, the farther the jumping distance. Can also be used with the jump key. Also permanently increases Movement Speed and Max Movement Speed.

skills.name: Call Monkey
skills.description: Summons the Cannoneer's faithful partner, Monkey.\nTo deactivate this skill, use it a second time. Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Cannon Jump
skills.description: Fires your cannon at the ground, using the recoil to launch you high into the air, and damaging nearby enemies. Can be used in mid-air by simultaneously pressing the Up Arrow key and Jump Key. Can be used up to twice in a row.

skills.name: Critical Fire
skills.description: Permanently increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Cannon Mastery
skills.description: Enhances Cannon Mastery.

skills.name: Barrel Bomb
skills.description: Rolls out an Oak Barrel full of bombs. The Oak Barrel will travel a short distance, knocking back enemies in its path, before exploding. Can be resisted by some enemies..
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Pirate Training
skills.description: Increases STR and DEX through secret Pirate training.

skills.name: Agile Cannons
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Scatter Shot
skills.description: Attack multiple enemies at once by firing a multitude of small bombs.

skills.name: Barrel Bomb
skills.description: Rolls out an Oak Barrel full of bombs. The Oak Barrel will travel a short distance, knocking back enemies in its path, before exploding. Can be resisted by some enemies..

skills.name: Monkey Magic
skills.description: Uses the magic of your monkey buddy to increase the HP, MP, all stats, Speed, and Jump of all nearby party members for a short time. Can be stacked with other buffs.

skills.name: Cannon Crash
skills.description: Blasts forward with a turbo engine built into your Hand Cannon.

skills.name: Reinforced Cannon
skills.description: Permanently increases Final Damage, Attack Power, and Attack Speed by strengthening the cannon.

skills.name: Pirate Rush
skills.description: Permanently increases HP, Defense, Status Resistance, and Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Counter Crush
skills.description: Chance to counter any hit taken by swinging the cannon. Increases Final Damage permanently.

skills.name: Monkey Fury
skills.note: Invisible skill in the WZ (no name/description in the skillbook); included as-is.

skills.name: Cannon Spike
skills.description: Summons a cannon that shoots a large number of shells at multiple enemies.

skills.name: Forty Winks
skills.description: Your monkey flings magic powder around that makes the enemy drowsy.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice cooldown will be reduced.

skills.name: Monkey Fury
skills.description: Fires a special elastic cannonball that coats all enemies ahead of you with gunpowder to deal damage. Use the skill again to immediately blow the cannon.

skills.name: Monkey Mortar
skills.description: Fires Monkey into the air on a mortar shell which then detonates. Periodically readies 1 Monkey Mortar.\nIn Auto-Mode, a Monkey Mortar is consumed each time Cannon Bazooka or Cannon Barrage hits an enemy, causing an explosion at their location.\nRight-click to toggle Auto Mode On/Off

skills.name: Cannon-Proof
skills.description: Set of explosions that cause a chain reaction and deflect the enemy's attacks.\nUnaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Double Down
skills.description: Try your luck! Roll two dice, and if both have the same number, you'll receive a very powerful buff.

skills.name: Mega Monkey Magic
skills.description: Upgrade your monkey's magic to temporarily increase the HP, MP, all stats, Speed, and Jump of all nearby party members. Can be stacked with other buffs.

skills.name: Cannon Overload
skills.description: Pushes your cannon to the limit. Increases Final Damage, Cannon Mastery, Attack Speed, Ignore Defense.

skills.name: Pirate's Spirit
skills.description: Your Pirate Spirit makes you strong, permanently increasing your Counterattack Rate, Knockback Resistance, and Boss Damage.

skills.name: Cannon Bazooka
skills.description: Fires a powerful cannon full of compressed gunpowder to burn enemies ahead of you to the ground.

skills.name: Nautilus Strike
skills.description: Order the Nautilus to attack multiple enemies at once. Nautilus is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Anchors Aweigh
skills.description: Places an anchor that creates a strong magnetic field. The magnetic field pulls enemies toward it. When the anchor disappears, it explodes, dealing critical damage to all nearby enemies. This skill is unaffected by enemy damage reflection skills.

skills.name: Support Monkey
skills.description: Summon an elite monkey artillerist to aid you in battle.\nTargets the boss with the highest Max HP first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Cannon Barrage
skills.description: Fire multiple cannonballs at once, focusing on one enemy ahead of you. Grants a bonus to Critical Rate and ignores enemy DEF. Targets the enemy with the highest max HP within range.

skills.name: Rolling Rainbow
skills.description: Order the Cannoneer's reliable assistants to summon three cannons and mercilessly roast enemies ahead of you. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Buckshot
skills.description: Applies a special buckshot to the Cannoneer's ammunition, increasing the number of attacks, up to a maximum of 15. Does not apply to summoning skills, 5th Job Common Skills, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Support Monkey - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Support Monkey's damage.

skills.name: Support Monkey - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of Support Monkey.

skills.name: Support Monkey - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Support Monkey.

skills.name: Cannon Bazooka - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Cannon Bazooka damage.

skills.name: Cannon Bazooka - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Cannon Bazooka.

skills.name: Cannon Bazooka - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Cannon Bazooka's attack count.

skills.name: Cannon Barrage - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Cannon Barrage damage.

skills.name: Cannon Barrage - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Cannon Barrage critical chance bonus.

skills.name: Cannon Barrage - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Cannon Barrage's attack count.

skills.name: Loaded Dice
skills.description: The next time you use Roll of the Dice, you get to throw an extra die and choose your desired number (via the number keys). Jobs without Roll of the Dice will be allowed to use the Roll of the Dice skill and choose their desired number.
skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Loaded Dice).

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice's cooldown will be reduced by 50%.

skills.name: Cannon of Mass Destruction
skills.description: Fire a gigantic rocket from your cannon. Unaffected by attack reflection. Use with the down arrow key to fire all the rockets at once.\nIn speed reduction mode, the flying speed is halved when the rocket collides with the enemy.\nRight-click to toggle speed reduction mode ON/OFF.
skills.note: Cannon of Mass Destruction.

skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Overdrive).

skills.description: Summon the special Champion Monkey Platoon that will help you in battle. The platoon is comprised of 3 members, Basic Roy, Speedy Maxi, and Explosive Khakee, and is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Poolmaker
skills.description: Bombards the earth with meteoric strikes. After a short delay, those strikes hit enemies near the Cannoneer, prioritizing boss monsters, enemies with the highest HP, and enemies that have survived previous strikes, in that order. Supplies will drop to support you and your party members during the first bombardment.\nIf there are no platforms for the strikes to fall onto, or if you're hanging on a rope or ladder, supplies will not drop. If the cooldown is reset while there are still strikes in reserve, the skill will end.\nStrikes are unaffected by attack reflection. To pick up the supplies, go near them and press the Up arrow key.
skills.note: Poolmaker (main entry).
